snippet.title: Bank Simulator: The Big Deal Update | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Big Deal is here. Bank Simulator’s Early Access V2, our biggest update yet, is available now on Steam.

Take deposits, invest your customers’ money, and grow a small branch into a financial empire. Early Access V2 changes everything from the previous version: the gameplay has been reworked at every stage, from how money flows through your bank to how you bring new customers through the door. On top of that, we’ve added a wave of exciting new features.

#BankSimulator #EarlyAccess #TycoonGame #SimulationGame #ManagementGame #SteamGames #IndieGame
